profile.headline: Full Stack Developer | Embedded Systems Specialist | Real-Time Software & Hardware Integration
profile.summary: Embedded Systems Engineer and Full Stack Developer with extensive experience in real-time software development, IoT solutions, and cloud-based applications. Passionate about building innovative, scalable embedded systems and real-time solutions that drive next-generation technology.

positions.title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Coordinated technical meetings with semiconductor manufacturers to evaluate next-generation processors for advanced charger systems.

Prototyped software solutions on multiple microcontrollers (MCUs) to support next-generation charger development.

Ported and updated legacy battery charging control software to new processors, optimizing for enhanced performance, compatibility, and evolving requirements.

Designed and implemented custom USB and SPI bootloaders across multiple MCU platforms, enabling robust firmware update and communication strategies.

Developed a multi-processor custom bootloader utilizing both USB and SPI communication protocols for next-generation processors.

Implemented USB and SPI driver logic, integrating functionality into next-generation processor platforms.

Expanded customer-requested functionality in existing charger systems, delivering customized solutions to meet evolving requirements.

Implemented the Incremental Train Control (ITC) protocol on a Single Board Computer (SBC) interfacing with existing battery charger systems.

Designed, implemented, and tested real-time embedded software for Bluetooth-enabled Summit II chargers and Lighting Transformer products.

Designed, implemented, and tested mobile apps for Bluetooth-enabled Summit II chargers and Lighting Transformer products.

Architected, designed, and implemented full-stack RESTful AWS web applications which process, analyze, and render data visually.

Designed and administered MySQL database architecture for the Summit II AWS cloud solution.

Increased efficiency in lab and factory by developing multiple GUIs utilizing Python and C# WinForms to configure/control products over CAN/RS485.

Improved Summit II charger’s IoT functionality by designing, developing, and testing a Linux-based device to continually scan/connect to chargers and upload pertinent information to the AWS cloud solution.
positions.insights: Embedded Systems, Configuration Management and +13 skills

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and tested battery charging algorithms.

Designed, implemented, and tested real-time embedded software for a charger development project using Freescale MQX RTOS on a Freescale Kinetis 32-bit MCU.

Designed, implemented, and tested real-time embedded software for a High Frequency Switch Mode Charger utilizing a TI Piccolo 32-bit MCU.

Implemented multiple GUIs tools utilizing python and C# Winforms to support lab development.
positions.insights: Embedded Systems, Configuration Management and +13 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead on handheld software definable Linux based radio product where we successfully demonstrated to government officials the feasibility of the technology.

Designed, implemented, and tested a custom GPMC Linux kernel module device driver used to communicate with a FPGA. 

Designed, implemented, integrated, and tested the transmit signal processing portion of the SRW military waveform - first in MATLAB then using a Coherent Logix HyperX™ multiple core FPGA replacement processor.

System level debugging/testing of various military waveforms including SRW, SATCOM DAMA, and SINCGARS.

Investigated the potential use of a Wind River Type 1 hypervisor in various products.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of system team in charge of developing software architecture for the JTRS Cluster 5 software definable radio.

Worked on project from inception and have worked to support system requirements, participated in software design review (SDR) presentation to government, CI definitions, software requirements specifications (SRS), and software design documents.

Created technical briefs to support software and system design for the TRS Cluster 5 software definable radio.

Development of HMI for military radio.

Team lead on a team that was utilized to test and optimize military radio communications.

Optimized code footprint on an embedded DSP and implemented new functionality to communicate with another processor.

Deployed with Army Ranger team at White Sands Missile Range to demonstrate military radio functionality to congressional leaders.

Lead software engineer on inter-division project where I lead the effort to integrate multiple technologies.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and tested real-time device drivers for Motorola 568XXX family of DSPs.

Designed, developed, and tested applications which utilize real-time device drivers for Motorola 568XX family of DSPs.

Technical project lead for Feature Phone product developed by Motorola and Telcordia.

Technical interface between third party vendor Telcordia.

Worked with international teams in producing algorithms and applications for Motorola 568XXX family of DSPs.

Ported algorithms and applications from third party vendors to Motorola 568XXX family of DSPs.

Participated in design and code reviews with software developers. This resulted in the development of portable reentrant real-time software.

Provided benchmarking of competitors.

Created training modules for organization products.

Provided customer support for developed software.

Created software installation packages for developed software products with InstallShield software.
positions.insights: Embedded Systems, Configuration Management and +11 skills

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed real-time device driver API. Prototyped and simulated API functionality on Win32 platform and integrated API onto real platform providing a custom hardware interface to application.

Developed real-time device drivers on Liberty operating system for DMAs and LinkPorts on SHARC DSPs.

Developed FPGA/DSP loader using real-time distributed APIs.

Integrated commercial off the shelf hardware into the WITS/DMR software definable military radio platform to provide an intermediate software development platform while hardware engineering team was developing custom hardware.

Technical software lead for WITS/DMR software definable radio product data flow design. Was responsible for design, implementation, testing, and integration of flow control objects into the system software, as well as multiple waveforms used by WITS/DMR software definable military radio.

Developed simulated device drivers for Windows NT using Win32 APIs. These simulated device drivers were part of the larger simulation environment, allowing developers to design, implement, and test their software without real hardware platform, reducing cost and development cycle time.

Participated in WITS/DMR software and hardware integration, which included responsibilities for bringing together.

Participated in design and code reviews with software developers. This resulted in the  development of portable reentrant real-time software.

Participated in technical support of third-party software developers which included software development environment installation and training of developers.

Participated in multiple product demonstrations, which included installation, demonstration, and technical assistance. Some of these demonstrations were conducted at the Pentagon and Lockheed Martin facilities. These shows were intended for current and potential customers.
positions.insights: Embedded Systems, Configuration Management and +8 skills

positions.title: Hardware Engineer
positions.description:
Performed system level trouble shooting of LST-5D miliary radio hardware.

Designed test equipment to test power amplifier in the LST-5D radios.

System level testing and coding of DAMA waveform (MIL standards 181, 182, 183) for production radios.
